summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtins feature. Changes: botocore/regions.py gained the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) enum with eleven members and per-member comments. botocore/args.py gained the EPRBuiltins import, a tolerant STS predicate (accepts endpoint_config=None), and compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults on ClientArgsCreator. tests/unit/test_args.py gained TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with 20 tests. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py 57 passed; test_regions.py, test_client.py, and test_args.py together 413 passed. Not verified: black and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so formatting was checked only by line length (all added lines at or under 79 columns) and by hand. Choices: SDK_ENDPOINT is None when absent so all eleven keys are always present; FIPS and DualStack use the bridge's private lookup methods. Nothing is committed.
